title: British Cheese Fritters
description: A crispy and hearty British-inspired snack featuring cheese fritters made with curds and a hint of savory flavors.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together flour, salt, and black pepper.
Add grated cheese curds, bacon bits (if using), and whisk until just combined.
In a separate bowl, whisk together eggs and buttermilk.
Pour wet ingredients into dry ingredients and stir until just combined. Do not overmix.
Using a spoon, drop small balls of the mixture into hot oil.
Fry fritters until golden brown, about 3-4 minutes.
Using a slotted spoon, remove fritters from oil and place on paper towels to drain excess oil.
